script.title: MONEY FOR MANILA
script.scene_zh: 匯款行 · 給媽媽匯錢
script.story_hook: A daughter sends birthday money overseas.
script.intro_zh: 她想趁媽媽生日，把錢匯到國外。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we send money abroad. Listen for fees and timing questions.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們到匯款行匯錢出國。留意問費率和時間的句子。
script.outro: Money sent, mom smiling. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 錢匯出去了，媽媽也開心了。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each transfer phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀匯款常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with long straight black hair in a low ponytail, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan, dark jeans and white sneakers, slim build, holding a small envelope of cash
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man in his forties with short graying hair and a neat mustache, wearing a navy vest over a light blue shirt, dark slacks and black loafers, stocky and calm

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry, I need to send money overseas.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ sɑɹi aɪ nid tə sɛnd ˈmʌni ˌoʊvɚˈsiz/
dialogue.zh: 你好，打擾一下，我想匯錢到國外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Where's the money going?
dialogue.zh: 好的，沒問題。錢要匯到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To Manila, for my mother.
dialogue.zh: 匯到馬尼拉，給我媽媽的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much are we sending today?
dialogue.zh: 今天打算匯多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five hundred dollars, if that's okay.
dialogue.zh: 五百塊，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally. Cash, card, or bank transfer?
dialogue.zh: 當然。現金、刷卡還是銀行轉帳？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, cash. I brought it with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm kæʃ aɪ brɔt ɪt wɪθ mi/
dialogue.zh: 呃，現金，我隨身帶來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll need your ID, please.
dialogue.zh: 正好。請給我你的身分證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my license. Is that one okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz maɪ ˈlaɪsəns ɪz ðæt wʌn oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的駕照。這張可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Now the receiver's full name?
dialogue.zh: 很好。收件人的全名是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maria Santos. That's my mother.
dialogue.zh: 瑪麗亞·桑托斯，就是我媽媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Sign this little slip here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɑt ɪt saɪn ðɪs ˈlɪtl̩ slɪp hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。請在這張單子上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait... the last name looks wrong.
dialogue.zh: 等等……姓好像打錯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, what does it say?
dialogue.zh: 噢不，上面寫的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says Santoz, with a z!
dialogue.zh: 寫的是 Santoz，z 結尾！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check it myself. I'll fix it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ɪt maɪˈsɛlf aɪl fɪks ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我親自核對一下，馬上改正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. You scared me for a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju jʊ ˈskɛɹd mi fɔɹ ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 呼，你剛剛真的嚇了我一跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! That happens all day, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，說真的，我們整天都會遇到這種事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, when will my mom get it?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛn wɪl maɪ mɑm ɡɛt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我媽媽什麼時候會收到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two ways: express or economy.
dialogue.zh: 有兩種方式：速匯或平匯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Express is faster but costs more?
dialogue.zh: 速匯比較快，但是比較貴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Express lands today, fifteen fee.
dialogue.zh: 對。速匯今天就到，手續費十五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the economy one?
dialogue.zh: 那平匯呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days, and only five dollars.
dialogue.zh: 要三天，不過只要五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, it's her birthday on Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，她週六就要過生日了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take express. Three days is risky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk ɪkˈspɹɛs θɹi deɪz ɪz ˈɹɪski/
dialogue.zh: 那就選速匯，三天太冒險了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, one quick question first.
dialogue.zh: 好，我先問一個小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask away.
dialogue.zh: 請說，想問什麼都行。。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's today's exchange rate exactly?
dialogue.zh: 今天的匯率確切是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dollar buys fifty-five pesos.
dialogue.zh: 一塊美元換到五十五披索。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty-five? Is that a good rate?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti faɪv ɪz ðæt ə ɡʊd ɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 五十五？這匯率算好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pretty good, yes. Yesterday was fifty-three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹɪti ɡʊd jɛs ˈjɛstɚˌdeɪ wʌz ˈfɪfti θɹiz/
dialogue.zh: 算不錯。昨天只有五十三。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then today's my lucky day, right?
dialogue.zh: 那今天是我運氣好的一天囉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! It works out sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，有時候就是這麼巧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, express it is.
dialogue.zh: 好，那就選速匯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. So five hundred, plus the fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs soʊ faɪv ˈhʌndɪd plʌs ðə fi/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。五百塊，再加手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is the fee fifteen or twenty?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪz ðə fi fɪfˈtin ɔɹ ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 等等，手續費到底是十五還是二十？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen plus five handling, so twenty.
dialogue.zh: 十五塊外加五塊處理費，共二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Handling? What's that charge for?
dialogue.zh: 處理費？那一筆是在收什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The receiving bank takes a small cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈsivɪŋ bæŋk teɪks ə smɑl kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 收款那頭的銀行會抽一小筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, fair enough. I'll pay cash.
dialogue.zh: 啊，這様就講得通了。我付現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five twenty, then. Count it if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈtwɛnti ðɛn kaʊnt ɪt ɪf ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那就是五百二十。你可以數一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No need. I counted it twice at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd ɪt twaɪs æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 不用了，我在家裡已經數兩遍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, careful sender! All good here.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，真是細心的匯款人。數目剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will anyone call my mom about it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ˈɛniˌwʌn kɔl maɪ mɑm əˈbaʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會有人打電話通知我媽媽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No calls. We text a pickup notice.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kɔlz wi tɛkst ə ˈpɪkˌʌp ˈnoʊtɪs/
dialogue.zh: 不打電話。我們會傳簡訊通知取款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice. She has a very old phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs ʃi hæz ə ˈvɛɹi oʊld foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那真好。她用的是很舊的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Texts still work on those, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛksts stɪl wɜɹk ɑn ðoʊz doʊnt ˈwɜɹi/
dialogue.zh: 舊手機也收得到簡訊，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the text actually say?
dialogue.zh: 那則簡訊到底會寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A code and the branch address.
dialogue.zh: 一個取款碼，再加一個分行地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then she shows the code, gets cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi ʃoʊz ðə koʊd ɡɛts kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 接著她出示碼，就能領到現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, plus her ID. She's done.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，再附上身分證，就領好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can she pick it up anywhere?
dialogue.zh: 她可以在任何地方領取嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any branch in her town. See this list?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni bræntʃ ɪn hɚ taʊn si ðɪs lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 她鎮上任何間分行都行。看這張清單？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You printed it already? So helpful!
dialogue.zh: 你已經印好啦？也太有幫助了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're old-school like that. Keep this receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹ ˈoʊldˌskul laɪk ðæt kip ðɪs ɹɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 我們這一行作風比較舊。收據請收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do I keep it, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du aɪ kip ɪt ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那這張我要留多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety days. The tracking number is on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti deɪz ðə ˈtɹækɪŋ ˈnʌmbɚ ɪz ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 九十天。上面有查單用的編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the number? I don't see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛɹz ðə ˈnʌmbɚ aɪ doʊnt si ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 編號在哪裡？我看不太到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom right, after REF. Have a great day!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəm ɹaɪt ˈæftɚ ˌɑɹiˈˈɛf hæv ə ɡɹeɪt deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 右下角，REF 後面。祝你今天愉快！

script.youtube_title_en: "You Scared Me for a Second" — Sending Money Abroad at a Transfer Counter
script.youtube_description:
60句跨國匯款聽力練習：第一次到匯款行，手續費、匯率、速匯和平匯到底該怎麼選？

這一集跟著一位細心的客人，為媽媽的生日匯五百美元到馬尼拉。從出示身分證、簽單、發現名字打錯的小驚嚇，一路聽到費率怎麼算、簡訊取款碼怎麼用、收據要留幾天。

你會聽到：
- 問金額、問到帳時間的實用問句
- 手續費、處理費、匯率的說法
- 速匯與平匯怎麼比較、怎麼決定
- 取款簡訊、編號與收據的細節

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把整段對話聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of overseas money transfer listening practice: a daughter sends birthday cash to Manila and learns to ask about fees, compare express and economy routes, check the exchange rate, and read the pickup code text.

You will hear how to show ID, fix a misspelled name, ask when the money arrives, and keep the receipt safe. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.
